excerpt: Shall the City of Lawrence, Kansas be authorized to repeal the 2019 Sales Tax in the amount of two tenths of one percent (0.2%) in the City of Lawrence, Kansas, and replace it with the levying of a new special purpose retailers’ sales tax in the amount of three tenths of one percent (0.3%) for the purposes of operating a City Public Transit System, including purchasing and maintaining buses and other transit vehicles, constructing and maintaining transit facilities, and purchasing and maintaining equipment and such other related Public Transit purposes as may be in the best interest of the City, with such special purpose retailers’ sale tax to take effect on the 1st day of April, 2027, if approved by a majority of the qualified electors voting thereon. The new special purpose retailers’ sales tax referenced herein, if approved by a majority of the qualified electors voting thereon, shall expire after ten (10) years from the date upon which such tax is first collected. [Note: In the event that the new special purpose retailers’ sales tax referenced herein is not approved by a majority of the qualified electors voting thereon at the November 3, 2026, general election, then the 2019 Sales Tax shall not be repealed and shall remain in full force and effect until it expires in accordance with the terms of Ordinance No. 9549.]
